title: Attain the joint rank-seven packing cap exactly at T740
body:
## Summary

```text
10 interleaved PR3018 T74 copies + 550-row journal
  -> legal T740 allocation, 335 destination changes
  -> exact fixed-word fractional packing cap
```

Close PR3018's remaining integrality gap for PR2979's words. The complete complex moment endpoint rises from `0.0017290342130642563` to `0.0017290357648755162`, a certified gain in `[1.5518112598719331e-9, 1.5518112598719333e-9]`. A tight-pattern identity proves `20|T`, making T740 the first eligible multiple of T74. This is a finite allocation and moment result. Supplier admission, an outer exponent and the selected frontier remain separate.

Only `research/rank7-cap740/` is added. [Proof, journal, sources and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/315df10c07cf8b8ee9af9b2122750635bb2582ae/research/rank7-cap740). Canonical main and priority revision 6 were refreshed before submission. The changed `independent-moment` scope takes the larger-replica handoff. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18980473).

Concurrent PR3022 reports a T148 finite improvement; its admission follow-up is distinct. PR3021/R1 has a stronger conditional headline, but neither its changed words nor its release is composed here. This construction reaches the underlying inventory's exact cap at a larger physical stock.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3018 retains two exceptional capacity-48 bins and an idle-rank-14 child at T74. **After:** the literal T740 histogram equals 740 times the verified fractional optimum, with every local child, idle child and all 91 private buffers charged.
- The retained owner checker streams all **2,717,280 roles**. A separate differential implementation checks 195 affected bins and 333 affected calls. Two internal read-only reviews independently reconstructed the journal's windows, masks and family exclusions.
- Rational verification covers all **2,551 patterns**, with 12 identically tight and 2,539 strictly positive reduced costs over the entire root bracket. The exchange improves every `0 < b <= 1/100`; a residue identity proves the replica constraint.
- Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays, eight behavioral test groups, optimized controls, warnings-as-errors, Ruff and all **25 committed/input byte checks** pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-cap740
```

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3018, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Mason Hale, Jeremy Kothe, Jeremy Diviney, Yiyang Lu, Tekalign, Ross Richardson, Dugongue, icekylinx, themilkman216 and the retained geometry/native/owner lineage. Substantial automated assistance was used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

Next: materialize the journal-derived T740 owners, rederive all T-dependent physical/prefix constants and run a fresh native/admission/modern-outer release. The README records exact open questions and the separate R1-composition obligation.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

One additive opt-in research package. No frozen source, shared checker, selected result or other PR disposition changes. Native/warp semantics, arbitrary dirty restoration, physical backing/movement/storage, precision/tape, caller and all-size/compiler/outer obligations remain inherited or unchecked for this larger construction. The stock equation is not a physical execution proof.
